common.systemName: Official System for Property Registration & Inventory for Lebanese Municipalities
common.errorBody: An unexpected error occurred. Try again, and if it keeps happening contact the municipality.

auth.staffLoginDesc: Enter your email and password to proceed
auth.sessionExpired: Session expired. Please sign in again.
auth.encryptedDesc: Login and session data travel across a fully encrypted channel.
auth.scopedDesc: Each account has defined permissions, showing only work-relevant records.
auth.auditLoggedDesc: Every sign-in attempt and system action is logged with timestamp and user.
auth.resetPasswordDesc: Choose a new password for your account.
auth.passwordUpdatedDesc: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in with it.
auth.invalidResetLinkDesc: This password reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one from Settings, or contact your system administrator.
auth.emailChangeConfirmedDesc: Your sign-in email address has already been updated. You can close this page and sign in.

citizen.enterReferenceHint: To view your properties, due fees, and payment receipts.
citizen.referenceMaskHint: Printed on your payment receipt and registration certificate. Dashes are added automatically.
citizen.dontKnowReference: Do not know your reference number?
citizen.billsDesc: Invoices issued against your properties and housing units, and payments history.

table.emptyHint: Try adjusting your search terms or filters.
table.emptySearchHint: Check the spelling or try broader terms.

payments.title: Transactions Log
payments.subtitle: Every payment in the municipality — who paid, by which method, and when
payments.approximateStamp: Time the record was last updated — no exact time is stored for partial payments
payments.searchPlaceholder: Search by payer name, phone, reference number, or transaction number…
payments.loadError: Failed to load the transactions log.
payments.receiptError: Failed to open the receipt — it can be issued from the citizen file.

errors.TENANT_MISMATCH: This request does not belong to this municipality.
errors.TENANT_NOT_PROVISIONED: This municipality is not set up yet.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Try again later or contact the municipality.
errors.FEE_NO_MATCHING_CITIZENS: No citizens match this category, so no notice will be issued.
errors.FEE_DUE_DATE_INVALID: The due date is not valid.
errors.FEE_NOTICE_NOT_FOUND: This fee notice could not be found.
errors.PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND: This payment could not be found.
errors.PAYMENT_ALREADY_PAID: This payment has already been settled.
errors.PAYMENT_ALREADY_UNDER_REVIEW: This payment is already under review.
errors.PAYMENT_STATE_CHANGED: This payment changed since the screen was opened. Refresh the page.
errors.PAYMENT_NO_PENDING_REVIEW: There is no pending payment to review on this record.
errors.PAYMENT_NOTHING_OUTSTANDING: Nothing is outstanding on this charge.
errors.CHARGE_ALREADY_PAID: This charge has already been paid.
errors.CHARGE_PAYMENT_PENDING: A payment on this charge is awaiting confirmation.
errors.CHARGE_CHANGED_DURING_CHECKOUT: This charge changed while the payment was being prepared. Refresh the page.
errors.PAYMENT_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: This invoice is in {currency}. Enter the amount in the field for that currency.
errors.EXCHANGE_RATE_MISSING: No official exchange rate is set. Enter a rate for this payment.
errors.EXCHANGE_RATE_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN: The official exchange rate is {rate, number}. Only an accountant or a system administrator can change it for one payment.
errors.EXCHANGE_RATE_NOT_SET: No official exchange rate is set. Ask an accountant or a system administrator to set one.
errors.PAYMENT_BACKDATE_FORBIDDEN: A payment cannot be dated more than {days, number} days before today. That correction is for an accountant or a system administrator.
errors.PAYMENT_RATE_REASON_REQUIRED: Give the reason for using a rate other than the official one.
errors.PAYMENT_BACKDATE_REASON_REQUIRED: Give the reason for recording the payment with an earlier date.
errors.PAYMENT_AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: The amount received must be greater than zero.
errors.PAYMENT_DATE_BEFORE_INVOICE: The payment date is before the invoice was issued ({issuedOn}).
errors.PAYMENT_TENDER_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: The amount in the invoice currency ({amount, number}) is more than the balance due ({outstanding, number}).
errors.PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: The amount received ({amount, number}) is more than the balance due ({outstanding, number}).
errors.TRANSACTION_NOT_FOUND: This transaction could not be found.
errors.TRANSACTION_ALREADY_REVERSED: This transaction has already been reversed.
errors.TRANSACTION_IS_REVERSAL: A reversal cannot itself be reversed.
errors.PAYMENT_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This operation’s identifier was already used for another invoice. Reload the page.
errors.INVOICE_NOT_FOUND: This invoice could not be found.
errors.INVOICE_NOT_OPEN: This invoice is no longer due: it was paid, or the register no longer charges it.
errors.INVOICE_NOT_CHARGED: The register does not charge this invoice.
errors.INVOICE_FIGURE_CHANGED: The charged amount changed since you opened the list. Refresh it and check the new figure.
errors.CITIZENS_ONLY: This is available to citizens only.
errors.PROPERTY_CARD_NOT_FOUND: This property card could not be found.
errors.OWNERSHIP_CARD_NOT_OWNER: This is not an owner’s card. To end a tenancy or an occupancy, use “End tenancy”.
errors.CARD_UNITS_CHANGED: One of the selected units is no longer on this card. Refresh the page.
errors.OWNERSHIP_SELECT_UNITS: This card covers more than one unit. Select the units whose ownership ended.
errors.OCCUPANCY_NOT_FOUND: This occupancy record could not be found.
errors.OCCUPANCY_NOT_OWNERSHIP: This occupancy is not an ownership. Use “End tenancy”.
errors.OWNER_CARD_COVERS_STRUCTURE: This owner’s card covers the whole building without naming its units, so the ownership of unit {unitCode} cannot be ended on its own. Set the card’s units in the owner’s file, or end the ownership of the whole building there.
errors.OWNER_NOT_FOUND: This owner could not be found.
errors.OWNERSHIP_NONE_ACTIVE: There is no current ownership to end.
errors.OWNER_HAS_LINKED_TENANTS: {names} {count, plural, =1 {is} other {are}} linked to this person as the unit’s owner. Remove the link from {count, plural, =1 {the tenant’s card} other {the tenants’ cards}} first, then correct the ownership.
errors.OWNERSHIP_END_BEFORE_START: The sale date is before the ownership was recorded ({startedOn}). Choose a later date.
errors.NEW_OWNER_ONLY_ON_SALE: A new owner is recorded only for a sale.
errors.NEW_OWNER_IS_CURRENT: The new owner is the current owner.
errors.NEW_OWNER_NOT_FOUND: The new owner is not in the register.
errors.OWNERSHIP_AFTER_STATUS_REQUIRED: Say who lives in the unit now.
errors.NEW_OWNER_REQUIRED_FOR_STATUS: Choose the new owner to record that they live there, or choose “I don’t know”.
errors.VACANCY_BASIS_REQUIRED: What is the vacancy based on?
errors.OWNERSHIP_CHANGED_CONCURRENTLY: This ownership just changed. Refresh the page.
errors.CARD_UNITS_CHANGED_CONCURRENTLY: This card’s units just changed. Refresh the page.
errors.TENANCY_ENDED_CANNOT_LINK: This tenancy has ended, so an owner cannot be linked to it.
errors.CITIZEN_NOT_FOUND: This citizen could not be found.
errors.OWNER_CARD_HAS_NO_LANDLORD: An owner’s card names no other owner to link.
errors.LANDLORD_IS_FILER: A card cannot be linked to the person who filed it.
errors.LANDLORD_DOES_NOT_MATCH: The landlord’s phone number or name does not match this citizen, and they are not a recorded owner of this property.
errors.CARD_LINKED_TO_OTHER_LANDLORD: This card is linked to another owner. Remove that link first.
errors.LANDLORD_LINK_CHANGED_CONCURRENTLY: This card’s owner link just changed. Refresh the page.
errors.OCCUPANCY_ENDED_CANNOT_LINK: This occupancy has ended, so it cannot be linked to an owner.
errors.OWNER_CANNOT_HAVE_LANDLORD: An owner is not linked to another owner.
errors.LANDLORD_IS_SELF: A person cannot be linked as their own owner.
errors.LANDLORD_NOT_OWNER_OF_UNIT: This citizen is not a recorded owner of unit {unitCode}.
errors.LANDLORD_RECORDED_AFTER_TENANT: This owner was recorded on unit {unitCode} after {tenant}. Confirm that {tenant} rents from them before linking.
errors.TENANT_CARD_NOT_FOUND: The tenant’s card for this unit could not be found. Refresh the page.
errors.UNIT_ON_CARD_WITH_OTHER_CAPACITY: Unit {unitCode} is on a card in {tenant}’s file with a different capacity. Correct that capacity on the card in their file first.
errors.TENANT_CARD_LINKED_TO_OTHER_OWNER: Unit {unitCode} is on a tenancy card linked to another owner{hasCurrent, select, yes { ({current})} other {}}. Remove that link from the tenant’s file first.
errors.TENANT_CARD_UNITS_UNSET: The tenant’s card in this building names no units, and they hold more than one there. Set the card’s units in their file first.
errors.UNIT_SPLIT_FAILED: The unit could not be separated from its card. Refresh the page.
errors.UNIT_NO_LONGER_EXISTS: Unit {unitCode} no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.LANDLORD_LINK_CHANGED_DURING_UPDATE: This card’s owner link changed during the update.
errors.TENANCY_ENDED_LINK_KEPT: This tenancy has ended. The link is kept as the record of who the owner was.
errors.OWNERSHIP_END_REASON_INVALID: An ownership ends with a sale or a transfer, or because it was recorded in error.
errors.TENANCY_END_REASON_INVALID: A tenant’s or occupant’s occupancy ends when they move out, or because it was recorded in error.
errors.CARD_IS_OWNER_CARD: This is an owner’s card. It has no tenancy to end.
errors.UNIT_NOT_ON_CARD: One of the selected units is not on this card.
errors.TENANCY_SELECT_UNITS: This card covers more than one unit. Select the units they left.
errors.TENANCY_NONE_ACTIVE: There is no current tenancy to end.
errors.OCCUPANCY_END_BEFORE_START: The end date is before the occupancy began.
errors.UNIT_STATUS_AFTER_EXIT_REQUIRED: Set the unit’s status after the occupant leaves.
errors.NON_RESIDENT_OWNER_CANNOT_OCCUPY: The owner of unit {unitCode} does not live in the town, so they cannot be recorded as living there. Choose “Vacant” or “I don’t know”.
errors.OCCUPANCY_CHANGED_CONCURRENTLY: This occupancy just changed. Refresh the page.
errors.UNIT_CORRECTION_PREVIEW_STALE: This unit’s data changed since you opened the preview. Review the new preview, then confirm again.
errors.UNIT_CONFIRM_CODE_MISMATCH: The code you typed does not match the unit’s code.
errors.UNIT_CORRECTION_UNVERIFIED: The result of the deletion could not be verified, so the whole operation was cancelled and nothing changed.
errors.UNIT_CORRECTION_BUSY: The unit or one of the citizens’ files is being edited right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.UNIT_NOT_FOUND: This unit could not be found.
errors.PARCEL_HAS_OTHER_BUILDINGS: {count, plural, =1 {A building is} other {{count, number} buildings are}} already recorded on parcel {parcel}. Make sure this building is not one of them before correcting.
errors.PARCEL_CHANGED_CONCURRENTLY: This building’s parcel number just changed. Reopen it.
errors.BUILDING_CODE_TAKEN: Code {code} is used by another building. Try again.
errors.BUILDING_NOT_FOUND: This building could not be found.
errors.PARCEL_NUMBER_UNCHANGED: That is already the building’s parcel number.
errors.CITIZEN_DUPLICATE_BLOCKED: This person is already registered: {name}. A second file is not created. Open their file and add the property there. If it really is someone else, a system administrator decides.
errors.CITIZEN_POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: This citizen may already be registered. Review the similar files before creating a new one.
errors.PHONE_BELONGS_TO_OTHER: This phone number is registered to someone else. Check whose number it is before saving.
errors.CITIZEN_FILE_STALE_MERGED: The filing behind this file changed since you opened the form (another file was merged into it). Reopen the file before saving.
errors.CITIZEN_EDITED_BY_OTHER: {name} edited this file after you opened it. Refresh the page to see their changes, or save to replace them.
errors.CITIZEN_EDITED_SINCE_OPENED: This file was edited after you opened it. Refresh the page to see the changes, or save to replace them.
errors.EDIT_REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason for this edit: it changes fields that need one.
errors.PROPERTY_TYPE_NOT_ACCEPTED: This municipality does not currently accept registrations of this property type ({propertyType}).
errors.TENANCY_ENDED_SINCE_OPENED: A tenancy on one of the cards ended after this form was opened. Refresh the page.
errors.PROPERTY_NOT_IN_LATEST_FILING: This property does not belong to this citizen’s latest filing.
errors.REMOVAL_REASON_FOR_KEPT_CARD: A card has a removal reason but was not removed. Refresh the page.
errors.SALE_REASON_OWNER_ONLY: “Sale or transfer” applies only to an owner’s card.
errors.OWNER_HAS_LINKED_TENANTS_ON_SAVE: {names} {count, plural, =1 {is} other {are}} linked to this person as the owner of a unit this save removes from their file. Remove the link from {count, plural, =1 {the tenant’s card} other {the tenants’ cards}} first and then save, or use “End ownership” if they sold it.
errors.CITIZEN_FILE_CHANGED_DURING_SAVE: This file changed while it was being saved (another file was merged into it). Reopen the file, then save.
errors.TENANCY_ENDED_ON_CARD_SINCE_OPENED: A tenancy on one of this card’s units ended after this form was opened. Refresh the page.
errors.CITIZEN_IN_MERGE: This file is part of an active merge, so it cannot be deleted. Undo the merge first if it must be deleted.
errors.CITIZEN_HAS_RECORDS: A citizen with filings, payments or fees cannot be deleted. Disable the account instead.
errors.MERGE_PREVIEW_STALE: One of the two files changed since you opened the preview. Review the new preview, then confirm the merge.
errors.MERGE_NOT_FOUND: This merge could not be found.
errors.MERGE_ABSORBED_CHANGED: The file being merged changed during the merge (something new was recorded on it). Reopen the preview and try again.
errors.CITIZEN_MERGED_AWAY: This file was merged into the file of {name}{hasReference, select, yes { ({reference})} other {}}. Use that file. A system administrator can undo the merge to separate them.
errors.LOCATION_INCOMPLETE: A location needs both a latitude and a longitude.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not connect. Check the network and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN: The request could not be completed. Try again.
errors.SESSION_INVALID: Your session has ended or is no longer valid. Sign in again.
errors.SESSION_ENDED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: This request did not come from the municipality’s portal.
errors.SESSION_REFRESH_UNAVAILABLE: The session could not be renewed. Check the connection and try again.
